1:morning.title: The Crack
1:morning.line: Mara took my hand. The Bell cracked at noon anyway.
1:morning.detail: The Hollow Choir came to finish the crack. I put it down with an iron rod and a memory I did not have yet.

1:afternoon.title: Ember Row
1:afternoon.line: The Ashwright fell. Ember Row smells of burnt sugar and iron.
1:afternoon.detail: The foundry heat did not stop us. Mara fought like the day had already happened.

1:night.title: What the Bell Keeps
1:night.line: I kept the warmth of the room. It will not survive the reset. I will.
1:night.detail: Inheritances are the only things the Bell cannot take back.

2:morning.title: The Checkpoint
2:morning.line: The Watch let us through on a lie and a ledger.
2:morning.detail: Iven knows the gate better than the people guarding it.

2:afternoon.title: The Watch Hound
2:afternoon.line: The Hound is dead. Iven did not look away.
2:afternoon.detail: The Watch trains its dogs to remember a scent across loops. It did not help it.

2:night.title: A Debt Paid
2:night.line: Elias is alive. The Watch will come for him before dawn.
2:night.detail: A ledger can be a life. I decided whose.

3:morning.title: Descent
3:morning.line: The counterweight hall is open. Iven trusts me with a lock.
3:morning.detail: Below the city, the Bellows are still moving. Nothing in Aurel ever fully stops.

3:afternoon.title: The Counterweights
3:afternoon.line: The Bellows fell. The Ashwright was waiting at the bottom.
3:afternoon.detail: The Choir sang the chains loose. We cut what was left.

3:night.title: The Choir's Offer
3:night.line: The Choir offered to take the memory. I said no.
3:night.detail: Some things must be carried, even when carrying them is the wound.

4:morning.title: Saint Orra
4:morning.line: Oria blessed me in the garden. The roses were already fading.
4:morning.detail: The garden remembers the dead first. Oria has learned to work around it.

4:afternoon.title: The Clockwork Saint
4:afternoon.line: The Clockwork Saint withdrew. Its bell heart was still ringing.
4:afternoon.detail: It was not trying to kill us. It was trying to finish a procession older than the Watch.

4:night.title: The First Wren
4:night.line: Wren is counting on the roof. She remembers more than she says.
4:night.detail: There was a Wren before this one. The name is older than the woman.

5:morning.title: Wren's House
5:morning.line: Wren's house. Toma drew a door that was not there.
5:morning.detail: He draws what he is afraid to say. The door looked like the one under the Spire.

5:afternoon.title: The Hollow Bellkeeper
5:afternoon.line: The Hollow Bellkeeper wore my face. I broke it.
5:afternoon.detail: It rang a bell that was not there. I still heard it.

5:night.title: The First Crack
5:night.line: The first Bellkeeper is alive. Her name is Orra Vane.
5:night.detail: She has been in the Quiet since before the Watch had a name for it.

6:morning.title: The Coup
6:morning.line: Sera moved against the Watch. I chose a side.
6:morning.detail: The city did not become safer. It became honest about who was holding the gate.

6:afternoon.title: The Watch Closes
6:afternoon.line: The street chose its side. So did I.
6:afternoon.detail: Whoever held the checkpoint, the cost was paid by the same people.

6:night.title: The Hollowed
6:night.line: One of us was hollowed. We brought them back.
6:night.detail: The Choir takes the shape of a person and leaves the rest. We did not let it keep anyone.

7:morning.title: Vey's Sanctuary
7:morning.line: Vey's sanctuary. The Quiet is closer than the Watch admits.
7:morning.detail: Vey has been keeping the door shut from the inside for longer than anyone knows.

7:afternoon.title: The Offer
7:afternoon.line: Vey offered mercy. The Saint of Ash offered a fight. I chose.
7:afternoon.detail: The Saint is made of every memory Vey took. Mercy is not the same as forgetting.

7:night.title: What Mercy Costs
7:night.line: Mercy cost more than the fight.
7:night.detail: The Quiet does not go away because someone forgives it. It only stops being fed.

8:morning.title: The Ascent
8:morning.line: The Spire stair. I carried a district with me.
8:morning.detail: Every district remembers a different Bell. I chose which one would climb.

8:afternoon.title: The Unbound Saint
8:afternoon.line: The Unbound Saint opened. The Bell was inside.
8:afternoon.detail: It was not guarding the Bell. It was trying to become it.

8:night.title: The Ninth Day
8:night.line: I chose what to do with the Bell. The ninth day will decide whether I meant it.
8:night.detail: Ring it. Break it. Become it. Every choice is a different kind of grief.

9:morning.title: The Last Morning
9:morning.line: The last morning. Wren gave me the hidden bell.
9:morning.detail: It is small enough to hold. It remembers the city before the loop.

9:afternoon.title: The Quiet
9:afternoon.line: The Quiet was Orra Vane. She wanted one more day.
9:afternoon.detail: The first Bellkeeper did not fall. She stayed.

9:night.title: The Ninth Day
9:night.line: The cycle ended. Aurel will remember or it will not.
9:night.detail: Either way, the Bell is quiet now.

mara.title: The Second Batch
mara.line: Mara burned the first loaf on purpose. The second one was for me.

iven.title: The Small Debts
iven.line: I read the names Iven let go. The Choir answered every one.

wren.title: Counting the Living
wren.line: Wren counts lit windows now. The number keeps going up.

oria.title: What the Roses Keep
oria.line: Oria cut a living rose and gave it to me. It did not wilt.

toma.title: The Page After
toma.line: Toma wrote tomorrow and did not cross it out.

vey.title: The Door Left Open
vey.line: Vey left the inner door open. The dark did not follow.

glossary.title: The Bell
glossary.body: The brass instrument at the top of the Spire. It rings at noon. When it rings, the day begins again. It is not a god. It is a machine that Aurel built around its own grief.

glossary.title: Inheritances
glossary.body: Memories that survive the Bell. Stat, skill, or bond. Six can be carried at once. The rest wait in the archive.

glossary.title: The Hollow Choir
glossary.body: A hymn with no congregation. It takes the shape of a person and sings the rest away. It is not evil. It is hungry.

glossary.title: The Ashwright
glossary.body: The foundry's keeper. It reforges what the city throws away, including people. Its hammer is still warm on Ember Row.

glossary.title: The Watch
glossary.body: The city's gatekeepers. They believe order is the only thing standing between Aurel and the Quiet. They are not entirely wrong.

glossary.title: The First Bellkeeper
glossary.body: Orra Vane. She rang the Bell first and has been paying for it since. Wren's mother. Sera's aunt. The Quiet.

glossary.title: Sera Vane
glossary.body: Watch commander, then rebel, then whatever the city needs next. She does not ask to be forgiven.

glossary.title: Vey
glossary.body: Keeper of the sanctuary. She takes memories the city cannot carry and keeps the door shut. Mercy is her oldest argument.

glossary.title: The Quiet
glossary.body: The silence between rings. It is made of every day the city refused to let go. It wears the first Bellkeeper's hands.

glossary.title: The Hidden Bell
glossary.body: Wren's small bell. It remembers Aurel before the loop. It is the only thing in the city that can answer the true ending.

glossary.title: Echoes
glossary.body: What a later loop remembers about an earlier one. The Bell cannot take the shape of your knowledge, only the day.

glossary.title: The Ninth Day
glossary.body: Break the Bell, carry the hidden bell, and keep all six bonds. Aurel remembers every loop at once, then chooses what to carry.
